failure.title: Bundled Docker SBOM plugin was incompatible with the current daemon API
failure.note: The third focused Docker protocol retained the exact plugin incompatibility transcript and clean teardown after QA-DKR-012 reached SBOM generation with QA-DKR-001 through QA-DKR-011 already passing.
failure.diagnosis: Docker Desktop exposed docker-sbom 0.6.0 with Syft 0.43, whose Docker API 1.41 client cannot inspect images on Docker 29 because the daemon requires API 1.44 or newer. The image and application were healthy; the obsolete bundled scanner failed before producing evidence.

rawEvidence.policy: Raw captures remain immutable in the developer-local vault; this public summary retains reviewed failure facts and cryptographic provenance without publishing browser traces, videos, logs, or mutation payloads.
